subtitle: 刘纪霆
headline:
Robot Learning & Embodied AI
Undergraduate in Mathematics
bioMarkdown:
I am an undergraduate in Mathematics at **SICAU**, with expected graduation in **2028**.

I am currently a Research Assistant in [Prof. Taku Komura’s group](https://www.cs.hku.hk/index.php/people/academic-staff/taku) at **The University of Hong Kong** ([Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab](https://hku-cg.github.io/mirod-lab/)). Previously, I was a Research Assistant in [Prof. Bo Zhao’s](https://soai.sjtu.edu.cn/cn/facultydetails/zzjs/zhaobo) [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/) at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University** (**2025–2026**).

acknowledgementsMarkdown: I am grateful to [Prof. Bo Zhao](https://soai.sjtu.edu.cn/cn/facultydetails/zzjs/zhaobo), [Prof. Gen Li](https://www.genli.top/), [Tao Lin](https://dorayakilin.github.io/), and [Yuxin Du](https://yuxin-du-lab.github.io/) for their mentorship and support during my research at SJTU, and to [Zhouyingcheng Liao](https://zycliao.com/) and [Dr. Wenjia Wang](https://wenjiawang0312.github.io/) for their guidance at HKU. Their advice and our discussions have helped shape my research interests and how I approach research problems.
researchInterestsMarkdown: My long-term research goal is to advance **general-purpose embodied intelligence** by exploring how agents can understand the world, learn from experience, and reliably accomplish diverse tasks in open-ended, changing environments. My current work focuses on **robot learning**, particularly the transfer of human experience, spatial representations, and model adaptation.
